caption: The drawing depicts two identical, symmetrical, metallic-looking objects placed side by side, each forming an open circular shape with four outward-pointing extensions that resemble arrowheads or stylized leaves. Each of these four prongs on both objects is equidistant from each other, giving the objects a cross-like appearance at four points. The two objects are joined at their adjacent sides, overlapping slightly in the middle. In the center of each prong, there is a small circular element that appears to be a rivet or screw, suggesting a mechanical connection. The color of the drawing is a uniform sepia or brown tone, with shading used to suggest texture and depth on the metallic surfaces. The background is plain and unadorned, rendered in a light beige color, while the objects are the only elements present and are centrally placed on the page. A small signature reading "Ben. Louis." appears in the lower right corner.
title: Hat-rack
